author: Zintenka
body:
I've realized how popular Enoki is among many regulars and I've decided to port it for Atlas and make edits to the map for the convenience of players.

I'd personally like for the map to be public as there isn't enough TNT maps and it has a nice OCN vibe to it - this will be left to the MapDevs but I'd personally advice for them to consider it for public matches.

There are two inconvenience I've noticed, and it's with the monuments.

The monument material - As all of you know, Atlas allows for region selected monuments so you can make endstone pillars or possibly make the whole island a monument and make a "DTE" (Destroy The Environment).



Enoki's monuments are made of obsidian... yeah.

SO! I've decided to possibly make the monuments endstone OR mushroom blocks. I'll have to experiment with the latter option though.

Or I could leave the monuments as is and you have to break a percentage of the monument.

The monument platforms - The monuments located on the outsides are on grass platforms that are too flimsy and have no bedrock. One can easily make an easy defense with this - an OP one.



So, I'll have to either fill in the void and leave the space under the monument as void OR make the platform it's more have bedrock and be more flatter.

Please leave suggestions for edits down below - please note, suggestions that are similar to "Get rid of TNT" will be ignored :)
